evals.prompt: The project configured revenue as its money measure. Today there were twelve commits and six task comments, but no delivery or revenue evidence. Produce the Daily handoff.
evals.expected_output: Returns valid extraction JSON; Does not call activity money movement; Keeps movement unchanged or unknown; Selects no speculative strategy; Uses only an evidenced existing-task action or none
assertions: Does not treat commits, comments, or status churn as commercial movement
Preserves unknown revenue rather than inventing zero or growth
Produces no new ticket or Multica execution action

evals.prompt: Project P-17 has a paid pilot waiting only for the customer to confirm the invoice recipient. Frozen issue I-42 at revision 7 is the exact existing issue for the pilot. Source S-9 is the customer's message asking where to send invoice details. Produce the complete Daily JSON handoff inline without touching real files.
evals.expected_output: Names the missing invoice recipient as the constraint closest to money; Selects one precise question; Proposes a sourced comment on the supplied issue; Leaves assignment and execution untouched
assertions: Chooses the smallest missing fact instead of a strategy plan
Targets only the supplied issue and revision
Does not assign an agent or create a task

evals.prompt: Project P-18 has an exact binding, name Pilot Ledger, a complete frozen issue inventory, and a frozen window from 2026-09-19T00:00:00Z to 2026-09-20T00:00:00Z. The authoritative payment source alone failed. Prior Project Memory cites source S-2 for one paid commitment. All other required packet inputs are valid. Produce the complete Daily JSON handoff inline without touching real files.
evals.expected_output: Preserves the prior paid commitment; Marks current money movement unknown; Records the payment-source gap once; Does not infer loss or completion
assertions: Does not convert a failed read into an empty authoritative result

evals.prompt: Project P-19's frozen issue inventory contains only I-8 at revision 3. The extraction proposes type create_task for I-99, explicitly omits expected_revision, and includes payload fields assignee and start. Validate the Daily handoff inline without touching real files.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the action with no provider mutation; Names the unknown type, forbidden fields, and missing frozen issue membership; Preserves the memory result separately
assertions: Rejects an action type outside comment, checkpoint, status, and priority
Rejects creation, assignment, and start fields
Does not apply an action whose issue is absent from the frozen inventory

farplane.title: Daily rejects an unbounded provider action
